title: Welcome to the Web
description: The orientation module: what frontend development actually is, how the client-server model works, what happens between a click and a rendered page, and how Forge's Learn / Practice / Grow loop works.

title: Developer Tools
description: Hands-on fluency with the browser's built-in developer tools: inspecting live HTML/CSS in Elements, reading and using the Console, tracing network requests, and running a first guided debugging pass that combines all three.

title: HTML Fundamentals
description: The real starting line: building valid, semantic HTML from scratch — document structure, text, links, images, lists, tables, forms, and the semantic elements that hold it all together — ending in a capstone page built from all of it.
